text:
Olivia: Quick question: for launch newsletter next Tues are we combining product announcement + webinar invite? want to avoid cannibalizing CTAs.
Hector: I'd separate them. Announcement Day1, webinar invite Day4. But for high-intent (trialers & partners) send a combined Day1 variant.
Samir: Agree. Segments: trialers_14d, engagers_30d, partners_list. trialers+partners get combined. engagers get webinar Day4.
Priya: Subject line plan for combined send: "New: X release + live demo (early access)". For webinar-only: "Live demo: deep dive on X". We'll A/B test tone.
Olivia: Routing note: registrants with enterprise domains -> tag `sales-lead` and route to SDR queue immediately. ops-bot: added webhook mapping to post to /sales/leads.
Hector: Add a soft gate for partners so we can surface partner-specific CTA. Also include calendar .ics for registrants.
Samir: Deliverability: run spam test and seed sends. Also throttle to 900/min. analytics-bot: estimated audience sizes: trialers_14d=2.6k, engagers_30d=7.1k, partners=420.
Priya: Nurture drip post-webinar: Day+1 recording, Day+4 technical deep-dive, Day+10 offer (extended trial). Owners: Priya/Samir.
Olivia: Inbound routing: registrants who request 1:1 on form -> immediate sales tag + email to SDRs. Those who just register -> nurture flow.
Hector: Preheader options? keep under 50 chars. I'll draft three variants and drop into the doc.
Priya: Legal check: don't promise discounts. Copy in doc for review by 5pm PT. Olivia will lock segments 12pm PT tomorrow.
ops-bot: Campaign "Launch X Release - Newsletter & Webinar" scheduled 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z with staggered sends.
Olivia: thanks, wrapping up. I'll post final send matrix and tag owners.
